title: Selection-Aware Stress Testing for Interactive Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.30916v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Agent evaluations often use one benchmark to choose a workflow and then search for task types where its advantage weakens, so both conclusions are selected from the same data. We introduce Selection-Aware Semantic Stress Testing (\SASST{}), which learns a task reweighting from pre-execution features on discovery tasks and evaluates the same paired comparison on separate confirmation tasks. The protocol checks support and stability, uses joint bounds for all planned claims, and can return no claim. We prove conditional asymptotic validity under stated cluster assumptions. A forty-cluster audit finds Gaussian undercoverage and conservative Bonferroni $t$ bounds. In one 480-episode $\tau$-bench study, a $3.75$ point discovery gain vanished on confirmation. A second-model study likewise confirmed neither a workflow benefit nor a stable stress rule.

translated_title: 面向交互式智能体的选择感知压力测试
translated_abstract: 智能体评估通常使用同一个基准来选择工作流，然后再寻找该工作流优势减弱的任务类型，因此这两个结论都是从同一数据中选出的。我们提出了选择感知语义压力测试（SASST），该方法从发现任务上的执行前特征中学习任务重加权，并在独立的确认任务上评估相同的配对比较。该协议检查支持度与稳定性，对所有计划的声明使用联合统计界限，并且可以返回“无声明”的结果。我们在给定的聚类假设下证明了条件渐近有效性。一项四十聚类的审计发现了高斯方法的覆盖不足问题以及Bonferroni t界限的保守性。在一项480回合的τ-bench研究中，发现阶段获得的3.75点优势在确认阶段完全消失。在另一项第二模型的研究中，同样既未确认工作流的收益，也未确认稳定的压力规则。
tldr: 该论文提出SASST方法，通过在发现任务上学习任务重加权并在独立的确认任务上结合联合统计界限进行验证，解决了智能体评估中从同一数据同时得出工作流选择和压力测试结论所导致的虚假优势问题。
en_tdlr: SASST introduces a selection-aware stress testing protocol that learns task reweighting on discovery tasks and validates paired comparisons on separate confirmation tasks with joint statistical bounds, preventing false positive claims that arise from drawing both selection and stress testing conclusions from the same evaluation data.
